slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review states that rural primary clinics in Zambia record on paper registers and tally sheets, aggregate monthly on paper reports and submit them to district offices for entry into DHIS2, the national HMIS platform, citing Health Policy and Planning 2023; the review gives no date for the position, so its publication date is used.

The review states SmartCare Pro had been rolled out to 877 facilities of 3,540 total as of 2025, citing the Global Fund's Zambia digital health case study, and that most rural clinics lack computers, reliable power and internet and remain paper-based; the count is of all health facilities, not primary clinics alone.

systems.tiers: entered at district offices from rural clinics' monthly paper reports
877 of 3,540 facilities (2025); limited SmartCare in select rural antenatal sites
